reference_sql:
SELECT order_line_id, country_code, net_revenue_eur,
       CASE WHEN country_code IN ('BE', 'LU') AND net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS priority
FROM sales
WHERE order_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
alternatives: SELECT order_line_id, country_code, net_revenue_eur, CASE WHEN (country_code = 'BE' OR country_code = 'LU') AND net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS priority FROM sales WHERE order_id >= 1 AND order_id <= 10

SELECT order_line_id, country_code, net_revenue_eur, CASE WHEN country_code NOT IN ('BE', 'LU') THEN 'no' WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS priority FROM sales WHERE order_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
